title: Loopscale — RateX PT Token Price Oracle Manipulation (Price Dependency)
root_cause: Vulnerable Price Dependency — RateX PT token pricing function used as collateral oracle, manipulable via spot price of the underlying Raydium concentrated liquidity pool in a single transaction
steps: Step 3: Open Leveraged Position in Loopscale
Loopscale reads spot price → collateral massively over-valued
Step 4: Reverse Swap / Flash Loan Repay
Large swap → spot price of collateral token spiked
Deposit collateral → borrow at inflated valuation
Reverse swap → SOL recovered → flash loan repaid
